article.headline: Samford opens season with an 87-58 win over Berry
article.description: — Will Shaver scored 17 points as Samford got its season underway with an 87-58 victory over Berry on Monday.
article.linkText: Samford opens season with an 87-58 win over Berry
article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Will Shaver scored 17 points as Samford got its season underway with an 87-58 victory over Berry on Monday. Shaver added six rebounds and four blocks for the Bulldogs. Cade Norris shot 4 for 4 from the field and 5 for 5 from the line to add 13 points. Najimi George had nine points and finished 3 for 5 from the field. Ryan Luttrell finished with 14 points for the Vikings. Cameron Pope added nine points for Berry. Reid Winton finished with six points. Up next Samford visits UNLV on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
